SGOV.name: iShares 0-3 Month Treasury Bond ETF
SGOV.description: Holds U.S. Treasury bills that mature within three months. The short maturities limit exposure to changes in interest rates.
SGOV.role: Provides the cash reserve and helps dampen swings in the portfolio.
SGOV.note: The dated holdings table includes cash-classified Treasury bills. The Nov. 20 issuer summary separately reports zero holdings.

IEF.name: iShares 7-10 Year Treasury Bond ETF
IEF.description: Holds U.S. Treasury bonds with seven to ten years remaining to maturity. These bonds are more sensitive to rate changes than Treasury bills.
IEF.role: An intermediate-term government bond option in the model's fund universe.

LQD.name: iShares iBoxx $ Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF
LQD.description: Holds U.S. dollar bonds issued by companies with investment-grade credit ratings. The bonds earn interest and carry both rate risk and the risk that borrowers weaken financially.
LQD.role: A corporate bond option for income and exposure outside government debt.

VTI.name: Vanguard Morningstar Total Stock Market ETF
VTI.description: Holds public companies of many sizes across the U.S. stock market. Its performance follows the broad market.
VTI.role: Provides the main source of stock market growth in the original mix.

VXUS.name: Vanguard Total International Stock ETF
VXUS.description: Holds stocks from developed and emerging markets outside the U.S. Its returns also reflect changes in exchange rates.
VXUS.role: Spreads the stock allocation across markets outside the U.S.
